flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: pages/NoticeUPL/{Form/RequestForm,Form/EndorseForm,Hooks/useEndorsement,List/EndorseList}, utils/mapping/NoticeUPL.ts, utils/data/LinkData.tsx (UPL menu commented out), App.tsx (route /upl/*), pages/CPS (Change Processing Stage). ocmsadminapi: crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/{ChangeOfProcessingController,ChangeOfProcessingService,EligibilityService,AmountPayableCalculationService}, crud/beans/SystemConstant, workflows/furnish/helpers/FurnishabilityChecker, auth/interceptor/OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor, api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminprivateapi: workflows/agencies/toppan/download/jobs/ToppanDownloadJob (RR3/DR3 -> CPC). Server handlers for approvalinbox, workitem, workflow (UPL_APPROVAL, CHANGE_STAGE) and court-process/process-cpc: not found in the six repos.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); the demo_remark is empty. Appendix D of Annex 1A is not in the repo. The UI side of the UPL decision exists (Decision Request and Endorsement pages; a 'not compoundable' decision selects stage CPC), but the UPL menu is commented out ('UNCONFIRMED', LinkData.tsx:396-397) and every server call it uses (/v1/approvalinbox, /v1/workitem, /v1/workflow with commands UPL_APPROVAL and CHANGE_STAGE, /v1/court-process/process-cpc) has no handler in the six repos and is absent from api-authorization.properties (except the /v1/workflow prefix). The stage moves to CPC that really exist in code are Change Processing Stage (CPS, covered by OCMS15.x) and the automatic RR3/DR3 -> CPC move after a Toppan download; neither is the 'court decision endorsed by the 2OIC' path. Tickets: OCMS-SR-2026-185 (22 Sep 2026) states that UPL processing logic has not been developed and UPL stages are patched manually; OCMS-SR-2026-107 (court-stage surcharge, Closed) and OCMS-DF-2026-095 (wrong current offender in the CPS report, Closed) touch the CPS path. Whether the workflow handlers live in another service outside the six repos cannot verify from repo. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is not used as evidence.
recommendation: Claim partially and with care. The UPL decision and endorsement screens exist but are hidden from the menu, and their server side is not found in the repo; the only proven move to CPC is through CPS and the Toppan cron. Court follow-up per Appendix D is not proven. Ask URA/the team to show in which repo the UPL_APPROVAL, CHANGE_STAGE and process-cpc handlers live, or mark a gap.

steps.step: The decision to charge the offender in court is recorded and endorsed by the 2OIC
steps.detail: The Decision Request page stores 'Is Compoundable': N sets processing_stage = CPC, Y sets DN1 (RequestForm.tsx:44-52, 62-78). The Endorsement page and the routes /upl/decision-request and /upl/endorsement are registered (App.tsx:83-85), but the UPL menu is commented out with the label 'UNCONFIRMED' (LinkData.tsx:396-397), so it does not appear in navigation. The decision data is posted to approvalinbox and workitem (useEndorsement.tsx:100-124; NoticeUPL.ts:129-194). No controller, entity or repository for approvalinbox or workitem was found in the six repos (grep approvalinbox, approval_inbox, workitem, work_item in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi), and those path prefixes are not in api-authorization.properties, which only lists /v1/workflow and similar (api-authorization.properties:23); the ocmsadminapi interceptor answers 403 for paths outside the mapping (OcmsAuthorizationInterceptor.java:57-72). The 2OIC role and any rule that the endorser differs from the requester are not visible in the repo (cannot verify from repo). OCMS-SR-2026-185 states that UPL processing logic has not been developed in OCMS.

steps.step: After the endorsement, OCMS triggers the escalation of the notice to the court processing stage
steps.detail: After an endorsement with approval = Y, the UI runs this sequence: POST /workflow command UPL_APPROVAL (useEndorsement.tsx:150-160; NoticeUPL.ts:104-127), read the stage days from parameterlist (useEndorsement.tsx:188-209), POST /workflow command CHANGE_STAGE with new_stage CPC (useEndorsement.tsx:210-216; NoticeUPL.ts:199-222), then POST court-process/process-cpc/<notice_no> (useEndorsement.tsx:219-227). The CHANGE_STAGE result is not checked before process-cpc is called, approval = N does nothing (comment at useEndorsement.tsx:201-203), and the sequence is driven by the browser, not by one server transaction. A server handler for /v1/workflow with commands UPL_APPROVAL and CHANGE_STAGE and for /v1/court-process/process-cpc was not found in the six repos (grep UPL_APPROVAL, CHANGE_STAGE, process-cpc, court-process; no controller maps /workflow); /v1/workflow only appears as a prefix in api-authorization.properties:23. So the UI-side trigger exists, but whether an endorsement really changes the stage cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The notice stage is moved to the court stage (CPC) and the processing dates are updated
steps.detail: The stage-move mechanism that exists in the repo is Change Processing Stage (CPS): POST /v1/change-processing-stage (ChangeOfProcessingController.java:46-47) calls processNotice, which checks eligibility, calculates the amount payable, and then runs updateVonStage in manual mode: prev_processing_stage = old last, last_processing_stage = CPC, next_processing_stage = CPC, next_processing_date = now (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:944-1074, 1093-1120). The change is synced to the Internet DB straight away (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1041) and one audit row is saved with authorised_officer = the user who ran it (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1049-1061). The CPS page is in the menu (LinkData.tsx:44-54; App.tsx:168-170) and allowed for functionId OCMS_CPS (api-authorization.properties:69-70). The stage also advances automatically RR3/DR3 -> CPC after a successful Toppan download (ToppanDownloadJob.java:409-410), but that is not the court-decision path. Partial because this mechanism is generic and not triggered by the 2OIC endorsement (a generic mechanism that is not the path the story names is Sebagian at best), and authorised_officer holds the CPS user, not the 2OIC who endorsed. Tickets: OCMS-SR-2026-107 (court-stage surcharge, Closed, Prod deployed) and OCMS-DF-2026-095 (wrong current offender in the CPS report, Closed).

steps.step: The escalation is applied to the current offender after the notice eligibility checks
steps.detail: CPS only handles the current offender: findCurrentOffender uses offender_indicator = 'Y' (EligibilityService.java:155-175), the role comes from owner_driver_indicator, and CPC is accepted only for the driver role (DRIVER_STAGES) or owner/hirer/director (OWNER_HIRER_DIRECTOR_STAGES) (EligibilityService.java:49-50, 69-123). PS notices are rejected except for codes DIP, FOR, MID, RIP, RP2; notices already at stage CRT/CRC/CFI are rejected; owner/hirer must have offence type O or E (EligibilityService.java:86-122). UPL notices are created as type X with offence type U (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:389-405), but the ONOD role of a UPL offender (driver or owner) cannot verify from repo; if it is recorded as owner, CPC is rejected with OFFENCE_TYPE_INVALID. Partial because this eligibility belongs to CPS and is not called from the endorsement path.

steps.step: Court-stage rules (surcharge, amount payable, furnish restriction) apply to the notice at stage CPC
steps.detail: When the new stage is CPC, AmountPayableCalculationService computes amount_payable = composition + surcharge (parameter SUR per stage code; CFC excluded) and processNotice also stores that value in the surcharge column (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1006-1030; AmountPayableCalculationService.java:103-124; SystemConstant.java:103-107), then syncs amount and stage to the Internet DB so eService changes too (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1041, 1191-1236). A notice at a stage starting with C cannot be furnished by the OIC (FurnishabilityChecker.java:237-242). This is part of a plausible 'follow-up', but Appendix D of Annex 1A is not in the repo, so whether this surcharge and restriction match Appendix D cannot verify; the SUR/CPC parameter value lives in the DB. All of it only runs through CPS (or the Toppan cron), not through the endorsement. Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-107.

steps.step: Follow-up per the Court Processing Workflow (Appendix D) picks up the notice that is at the court stage
steps.detail: The UI calls court-process/process-cpc after the stage changes to CPC (useEndorsement.tsx:219-227), but its handler is not in the six repos and its path is not in api-authorization.properties. No job in ocmsadminprivateapi selects notices at stage CPC for a court application: grep 'CPC' only finds stage lists, the payment flag in AutoRevivalHelper.java:1482-1490, and the Toppan stage fallback. The OcmsCourtCase entity is only used by PaymentAcceptanceCutoffServiceImpl and CasIntegration (court case data, not an escalation from CPC). Follow-up per Appendix D (court application, summons and so on) is covered by other stories (epics OCMS22 to OCMS28) and is not claimed here; Appendix D itself is not in the repo.
